summary: Petrobras filed a 6-K reporting the October 13, 2026 signing of Cost and Volume Balancing Agreements (AEGVs) with Shell, TotalEnergies and Petrogal for the Berbigão and Sururu shared reservoirs in Brazil's Santos Basin, following ANP approval of Production Individualization Agreements. Petrobras will receive a net ~US$859M from BM-S-11A partners, settling by November 2026. The AEGVs reconcile revenues, capex, opex and royalties from September 15, 2000 through April 30, 2026, per revised interests: Berbigão Petrobras 62.913%, Sururu 45.394%. Watch receipt timing and potential tax effects.
